records.Name: Glimmergold Association
records.Story:
As major shopping malls expanded and online shopping became more common, commercial streets like Glimmergold Lane, which were packed with small independent shops, gradually fell out of favor. To revitalize Glimmergold Lane and boost the local economy, the merchants here formed their own business association. Those who join organize cross-promotions, improve street facilities, attract visitors, and support local businesses, among other things.
Cross these mild-mannered shop owners and the consequence won’t be a beating. Instead, you’ll find yourself shut out by the community. Never again will a single shop’s light turn on for you, nor will you be able to find a warm meal or someone willing to help you fix a flat tire.

records.Name: Azure Sector Citizens
records.Story:
The Hub, located in the Azure Sector, serves as a showcase for Nova City’s development: a witness to the city’s rise and fall.
This neighborhood presents two very different faces. By day, The Hub fills with tourists from around the world, along with the business elite who work there. The towering Aerie Bank looks out over the Skyfall Memorial Park downtown, forming a celebrated tourist route. Come nightfall, however, the daytime bustle fades, like a party quickly coming to a close.
Get on the wrong side of these self-serving suits and there’s a real chance you’ll find your bank card frozen. There’s also the likelihood of becoming a punching bag for the next workout at the local gym.

records.Name: Downtown Citizens
records.Story:
Home to most of Nova City’s residents, the downtown area is the most densely trafficked and lively district in the entire city.
Notable landmarks include Glimmergold Lane and the Indigo Commercial Zone, where Nova City’s trendiest stores featuring the latest in electronics and collectibles are clustered. Heading east along Indigo Avenue, you gradually reach the more affluent areas, such as The Border Station and Skyfall Memorial Park.
Residents here all live their lives by the same credo. Among the maddening crowd, nobody knows anybody, yet everyone’s eyes are all pointed in the same direction; toward the brightest screen, the priciest shop, the coolest clique.

records.Name: Portview Lane Citizens
records.Story:
Portview Lane shoulders the weight of Nova City’s revival. Companies led by Marine MechWorks have gathered here, supplying the machines and tools needed for the city’s reconstruction.
As the city has grown, so has the prosperity of this district. You can visit the Thunderfire Industries workshop, which has taken Nova City by storm, or pose for a photo with the Starlit Cruise, a testament to Marine MechWorks’ formidable production power. 
The people here put faith not in presentations, but in the calluses on their hands. They are not big talkers, but when they make a promise, they keep it. Do not try to impress them with empty boasts; they can always tell.

records.Name: Veluxity Zone Citizens
records.Story:
和市区那街道干净整洁、商店鳞次栉比的形象不同，夕速区能满足所有精力旺盛，想要找点麻烦的游客们。
需要小心的是，这里聚集了不少街头势力和混厄窝点。不过别担心，只要你胆子够大，一定能在这里找到乐子，毕竟如果没有冒险，生活又有什么意义呢？

records.Name: Coastal Zone Citizens
records.Story:
Beaches, tourists, theme parks, and a zest for life. The Coastal Zone is Nova City’s premier vacation destination: a breathtaking stretch of golden coastline dotted with luxury hotels where visitors can enjoy the holiday of a lifetime.
Around here, a hotel doorman can greet two hundred regulars by name. That being said, if you’re not tipping, then you’re simply another stranger passing through.

records.Name: Future Port Citizens
records.Story:
To accommodate the city’s burgeoning population and provide residents with richer entertainment and retail options, an aging neighborhood in the eastern Coastal Zone was reclassified as an urban commercial district, designed to create an exciting new cityscape. Plans call for a large convention center and shopping mall.
However, this ambitious vision has been repeatedly stalled by the reality of a delayed construction timeline. The Reign Group’s maneuvering for a piece of the contract and the Chaos entities emerging from subway construction sites have left workers on the ground exasperated, and seemingly postponed this blueprint for the future indefinitely.

records.Name: DK9
records.Story: A pack of stray dogs drawn together by Garm, standing against every gang in Nova City. Garm hates being considered the boss, but everyone knows she was born for the role.

records.Name: NCCA
records.Story: The official law enforcement organization of Nova City, whose primary duty is to uphold order. Responsible for dispatching NCCA Officers throughout the city, it handles incidents which pose a threat to urban residents and penalizes human perpetrators of criminal activity within city limits.

records.Name: Gale Riders
records.Story:
A motorcycle gang that runs through Portview Lane and Paradox Plaza. Perpetually restless in a city of increasing order, they are unable to suppress their love for the sound of a roaring engine and the feel of the wind in their hair. They frequently ride through the streets of Nova City in packs.
Their look may be dated, but to them it represents a place and time when lawlessness still ruled the city, when a layer of industrial grime covered everything, and passion ran wild.

records.Name: Ronji Hood
records.Story: These Luminary Academy alumni, still clad in their uniforms, never really left Veluxity Zone behind. Maybe they’re nostalgic for the days they used to roam wild and free, or maybe they regret never taking their studies seriously. Don’t let their tough-guy look fool you, however, as they’re a pretty stand up bunch.

records.Name: G-Krew
records.Story: Sound is their weapon; flow is their ammunition. A street gang with an undying passion for hip-hop. Complain that their beats are too loud, and you may get beat up. Their favorite music label is Cypher Records, and their go-to radio station is Paradox.

records.Name: ParaBoar
records.Story:
A street racing crew active in Portview Lane and Paradox Plaza — and the organizers behind the Wild Boar, Nova City’s most notorious underground race. Naturally, they’re of significant interest to the NCCA.
In the dead of night, they treat the entire city as their track and race modified vehicles through streets that would otherwise be silent. They’re not crazy. They’re just faster than you.

records.Name: Black Metal
records.Story:
Borne from the “I’m In Love With My Train” incident, with Roger as their idol.
Chaos entities that emerged inside the train cars and joined the grand performance as avid fans.
Even in the wake of Roger’s defeat, the spirit of rock never dies, and new Black Metal continue to rise up.

records.Name: Masked Malice
records.Story:
“Can’t wrap your head around what we’re doing? We like it that way”.
A group of disaffected youths who somehow got their hands on a set of masks. When they first put them on, the Masked Malice was born. They split off and drift to every corner of the city, making it their mission to disrupt order and do as they please.

records.Name: Televised Collective
records.Story:
“Taking out garbage programming to bring minds together”. When people invested too much emotion and time into their televisions and computers, these Chaos entities with displays for heads begin appearing all around the world. They are naturally drawn to human memories and have organized themselves into a corporate-style hierarchy which mimics that of their human counterparts.
Note: Any display screen, after prolonged viewing, may absorb too much of a person’s thoughts and emotions and transform into a Televised Collective. For this reason, after every hour of screen time, please look away from the display and give your eyes a rest.

records.Name: 龙栖村市民
records.Story: 青山云雾深处的世外茶乡，一杯龙栖茶能让神仙下凡赖着不走。古色古香的石板路弯弯绕绕，村民热情得能把路人塞成炒货礼包。#r龙井村家家户户飘着茶香，日子过得比茶汤还回甘；不远处的虎侍禅院是远近闻名的打卡地——据说这儿的猫比香客还爱念经，蹭一蹭还能沾点好运。

records.Name: 西城区市民
records.Story: 这里的时间是按“一碗面”来计算的。老城区里凌云美食香飘十里，早茶未散夜宵已至。#r其中烟里巷是老饕的美食圣地——门脸儿破破的苍蝇馆子，桌子晃晃的路边摊，端出来的却是让高端料理大厨都自愧不如的绝活。街坊邻居见面就唠嗑，他们的日子过得比慢炖的老汤还要有滋有味。

records.Name: 东港区市民
records.Story: 城市的“钢铁胃口”就在这里消化。日夜不断的货运码头、自动化的工厂集群、还有从不打烊的交易港。#r空气里飘着机油味和海腥气，工人们说话嗓门大得能压过汽笛。这里没什么风花雪月，但每一座建筑里都装着凌云奔腾向前的野心。

records.Name: 瑞安新城市民
records.Story: 玻璃幕墙的摩天大楼耸入云霄，“凌云”二字名不虚传。#r作为本市最前沿的科技新区，云宙计划的机器人和无人机在天上地下满街乱跑，宙合园里散个步都得小心别被扫地机器人"追尾"。忙里偷闲的人们爱上凌云阳台吹吹风、眺望对岸，在这里，整座城市都在呼吸间日新月异。

records.Name: 明浦区市民
records.Story: 新旧碰撞出的最潮火花都在这儿。不夜港沿江夜景璀璨得让手机自动挂上滤镜，曜金路步行街人潮汹涌——走两步就可能被浪摄团的补光灯闪到眼睛。爱看电影的不妨去北方影视的基地逛逛，转角撞见明星大腕不稀奇，运气好还能当个群演，过把戏瘾。

records.Name: 万宁区市民
records.Story: 环湖漫步早已成为这里居民的日常，柳絮扑面，画舫悠悠，每一步都是赏心悦目。慧明禅寺的香火鼎盛，据说求签特别灵，就是签文写得像谜语。他们总说八崇塔下镇着不得了的东西——不过他们最关心的还是塔顶的观景台何时才能进去。#r要问他们的忠告？那就是：节假日千万别凑热闹去N.8。真要去？就做好在临湖步行街上被人潮推着走的准备吧。
